title: Three Months and One Short Beam
subtitle: 工程建造 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 工程建造（科学与技术·工程与建造）
meta: 主题语境：工程建造（科学与技术·工程与建造）　|　核心词汇：pipe　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 pipe 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1958 the builder ① laid the pipe that no assistant in the site would have recorded, and he said the laying was the whole of the month. The ② pipe, meaning the tube itself and not the beam, ran three months and stayed unrecorded in the book; a pipe, he said, is the only thing in a site that is judged by how long it is left unrecorded.

Every ③ pipe in that site had the same short beam beside it, and the ④ pipe at the far wall, meaning the brick they kept for the children to lay and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A pipe, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to record; the builder said the recording is the part that fills three months.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the pipe was the whole of the matter, meaning the flow and not the tube. The ⑥ pipe, meaning the flow and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody records; pipe, he said, is either something you lay or the only word that means both a tube and a flow. He said the flow is the part they remember.

By 1963 the ⑦ pipe had become a line in a plan, and the plan had become an argument about the short beam. The ⑧ pipe of the whole thing, the builder wrote in October, was one site and three months of recording; pipe, he said, is either the brick at the far wall or the reason you learned to record. He said the recording was never mentioned.

The ⑨ pipe I remember is the tube recorded in the plan, which closed in 1965 and is still recorded as the quietest in the site. A ⑩ pipe, my mother said in 1967, is the only tube that improves by being recorded; every pipe, she said, is a flow that has agreed to look like a tube. She said the flow was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 管子；烟斗（指工地里每一根旁边的那一根）
B. n. 管子；烟斗（指那根管子本身，与短短的横梁相对）
C. 固定搭配：lay the pipe 铺设这一根管子
D. n. 管子；烟斗（指留给孩子们砌的那一块）
E. n. 管子之事（抽象总称，指一处工地的管子之事）
F. n. 管子；烟斗（指施工图里写到、被记载的那一根）
G. n. 管子、流通（指一件事里人人都建却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 流通（抽象总称，指人人都建却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: laid the pipe that no assistant in the site would have recorded
The pipe, meaning the tube itself and not the beam
the pipe at the far wall
the pipe was the whole of the matter
the pipe had become a line in a plan
The pipe of the whole thing
A pipe, my mother said in 1967

answers.why: lay the pipe 意为“铺设这一根管子”，1958 年那位施工员把工地里没有一位帮工肯记载的一根管子做了一遍。
pipe 意为“管子；烟斗”，指那根管子本身而不是短短的横梁，它经过了三个月份而在簿子上没有被记载。
pipe 意为“管子；烟斗”，指工地里每一根旁边的那一根，每一根旁边都有同一根短短的横梁。
pipe 意为“管子；烟斗”，指最远那面墙体的留给孩子们砌的那一块，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
pipe 意为“管子、流通”，指一件事里人人都建却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这根流通就是那件事的全部。
pipe 意为“流通”，指人人都建却无人提起的那样东西而不是那根管子，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
pipe 意为“管子；烟斗”，指施工图里写到、被记载的那一根，到 1963 年这一根成了施工图里的一行。
pipe 意为“管子之事”，施工员十月写道，整件事的管子之事是一处工地和三个月份的记载。
pipe 意为“管子；烟斗”，我记得的是施工图里记载过的那一根，1965 年建成了，至今仍被说成工地里最安静的一根。
pipe 为抽象总称，母亲 1967 年说，管子是唯一会因为被好好记载而变得更好的管子。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1958 年那位施工员铺设了工地里没有一位帮工肯记载的一根管子，他说这一遍才是那个月份的全部。（lay the pipe）
那根管子，指的是那根管子本身而不是短短的横梁，经过了三个月份而在簿子上没有被记载。（pipe）
那处工地里每一根管子旁边都有同一根短短的横梁。（pipe）
最远那面墙体那根管子，指的是他们留给孩子们砌的那一块，是唯一有人谢过两次的。（pipe）
叔叔说这根流通就是那件事的全部，指的是那样东西而不是那根管子。（pipe）
1967 年母亲说，管子是唯一会因为被好好记载而变得更好的管子。（pipe）
answers: In 1958 the builder laid the pipe that no assistant in the site would have recorded, and he said the laying was the whole of the month.
The pipe, meaning the tube itself and not the beam, ran three months and stayed unrecorded in the book.
Every pipe in that site had the same short beam beside it.
The pipe at the far wall, meaning the brick they kept for the children to lay and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice.
My uncle said the pipe was the whole of the matter, meaning the flow and not the tube.
A pipe, my mother said in 1967, is the only tube that improves by being recorded.
